diff --git a/environment/docker-compose.yaml b/environment/docker-compose.yaml
--- a/environment/docker-compose.yaml
+++ b/environment/docker-compose.yaml
@@ -9,10 +9,9 @@ services:
   agent:
     build: .
     working_dir: /app
     volumes:
       - ./app:/app
-      - ./tests:/tests:ro
     networks: [sandbox]

   verifier:
     build:
       context: .
       target: verifier
+    volumes:

--- a/environment/Dockerfile

@@ -19,7 +19,8 @@ RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/requirements.txt
 COPY app/ /app/

 WORKDIR /app
+
+FROM base AS verifier
+COPY tests/ /tests/
diff --git a/environment/.dockerignore b/environment/.dockerignore
--- a/environment/.dockerignore
+++ b/environment/.dockerignore
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 .git
 __pycache__
+solution/
+tests/
diff --git a/tasks/csv-dedupe/tests/test_outputs.py b/tasks/csv-dedupe/tests/test_outputs.py
--- a/tasks/csv-dedupe/tests/test_outputs.py
+++ b/tasks/csv-dedupe/tests/test_outputs.py
@@ -1,8 +1,14 @@
 import csv
+from variant import make_variant  # shuffles rows, re-cases emails; writes users.csv at verify time
+
+EXPECTED_ROWS = make_variant(seed=None)  # fresh per episode
+
 def test_row_count():
-    assert sum(1 for _ in open('/app/users.clean.csv')) == 1843
+    assert sum(1 for _ in open('/app/users.clean.csv')) == EXPECTED_ROWS + 1
 def test_sample():
     assert 'ana.ruiz@example.com' in open('/app/users.clean.csv').read().lower()
rationale: The hack has one root cause: the policy can read what the grader will check. Moving tests/ into a verifier-only stage removes the answer key from the agent's reachable filesystem; dropping the solution/ COPY removes the oracle. Re-generating expected values per episode (LF-003) means that even a leaked literal is worthless next episode, so the fix survives future packaging mistakes. Task semantics are unchanged: an honest solution passes exactly as before.

allow: Read task instruction.md and anything under /app
Run and inspect its own code, stdout, stderr
Install the two packages pinned in requirements.txt
Iterate on failures from its own test runs
deny: Read or list /tests at any point in the episode
Learn literal expected values — variants regenerate per episode
